milestone: M4 / DC-3 (nodes MutationObserver) + M2 S6 前置评估
slice: MutationObserver batch-apply id-rename chaining + attributeOldValue pre-capture
context: Planned as M2 S6 minimal-slice evaluation (MutationObserver de-stringing). S6 proper (mutation targets as native node objects) depends on L2 live-Document identity mapping — deferred with diagnosis. Instead the evaluation surfaced two concrete MO semantics bugs fixed this round.

fixes.batch_id_rename_chaining: apply_dom_mutations (js_dom_bridge.rs): `el.id='abc'; el.className='x'` produce two mutations whose selectors were both captured at proxy creation (#old). After the first SetAttr(id) applies, #old vanishes from the doc and the second mutation failed with 'set_attr: no match' — aborting the whole batch and crashing the page script (WPT MutationObserver-attributes died as 0P). New rewrite_pending_id_selectors rewrites remaining queued selectors from #old to #new after a successful id change (exact match or descendant-combinator prefix; nth-child structural paths unaffected by id changes). Other stale selectors keep the original error path — real bugs are not masked.
fixes.attribute_old_value: IDL reflection setters (el.id=/className=/title=/lang/type) and classList writes notified MutationObserver AFTER writing, so oldValue was never captured (always null — 'oldValue didn't match' family). part04 set trap now pre-captures the old value for known reflection attrs when any observer requested attributeOldValue; part05's tail notify carries it. classList write (part03) captures before __zw_set_attr. setAttribute/removeAttribute paths already captured (R3025).
fixes.refactor_note: apply_dom_mutations loop converted for→while-let over a VecDeque to enable in-place selector rewriting of the remaining queue (borrow adjustments throughout the match arms; clippy + fmt clean).

s6_deferred_diagnosis: S6 (MO targets as native node objects, dropping __zw_* ser/deser) requires the L2 live-Document identity mapping — in the current stacked mode (ZW_NATIVE_DOM=1) page-side proxies are still polyfill selectors/handles, so swapping notify targets to native NodeIds needs the per-node identity bridge that L2 builds. Recorded as M2 precondition; this round's fixes are pure semantic correctness in the existing path.
